integrity: Finite tests corroborate a separate all-order Fourier and cyclotomic proof. External independent review has not been performed.
limitations: Restricted to the standard labelled GP(n,3) graphs with n>=7. Not a classification of all generalized Petersen steps. Unindexed prior work could already imply the same formula.
title: Exact dominating induced matchings of third-step generalized Petersen graphs
